title: Initial reachable set has size one
statement: Let $K$ be a natural number, let $R$ be a binary relation on the natural numbers, and let $	ext{Init}$ be a predicate on the natural numbers. If $u_0<K$ and $	ext{Init}(u)$ holds exactly when $u=u_0$, then the set of numbers below $K$ reachable in zero steps from an initial number has cardinality $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A binary relation R on natural numbers
A predicate Init on natural numbers
A natural number u₀ with u₀ < K
For every u, Init(u) iff u = u₀
